text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I will win――)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Go, Dants!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm... the one who's gonna wiiiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame...!! She has pulled off an 
incredible miracle! A magnificent 
comeback!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S, entering from the Classic 
Year, was also drawing immense attention, 
but...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A sheer ferocity that far surpasses the 
rest! Does Dants Flame know no defeat?! 
This is what it means to be an indomitable 
Umamusume~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...―― Flame――a scorching――heat――"
(WOOOOOOOOO!!)

Cheers like an earthquake's rumble envelop 
Dants Frame.

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Thank you, thank you, Dantsu Flame!

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I was watching the whole time...! Thank 
you for giving me courage!!

"She'll never be able to race again." 
Those words from the past were now 
completely rewritten—

The Tenno Sho (Autumn) came to a close 
with Dants Frame's presence becoming the 
center of attention—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I've received so many supportive comments, 
and I'm reading every single one. Thank 
you so much!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And so—there's something I want to talk to 
everyone about today!
Dantsu Flame told me everything.

Having missed out on the spotlight so many 
times. Suffering leg issues this summer, 
and at one point intending to step away 
from the front lines.

Although the treatment is currently 
complete, the condition carries a high 
risk of relapse, meaning a sudden 
retirement remains a possibility—

text_block_list.name: Umastagram Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, so you were just dodging the 
questions during that press conference?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I know everyone thinks of me as someone 
who works hard, is cheerful, and always 
stays positive."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I was terrified of stepping outside that 
mold. The real me is—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Quick to get discouraged, quick to fret. 
I've made it this far while contemplating 
retirement time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“The Indomitable Dantsu Flame” is way too 
good a title for someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
... I'm sorry for bringing up such a 
topic. I'm sure it hurt some people, 
too...

ââAnd with that. As if caressing her 
on the screen, a trail of colorful stamps 
glowed in succession.
And—

text_block_list.name: Umastagram Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm glad you told me." "Hiding 
your pain and smiling brightly takes real 
strength." "It makes me want to cheer for 
you even more."

text_block_list.name: Umastagram Comment
text_block_list.text:
"You may have struggled and agonized to 
get this far, but you always gave it 
everything you had." "In the end, you 
never gave up, did you?"

text_block_list.name: Umastagram Comment
text_block_list.text:
"You really are the 'Indomitable Dantsu 
Flame.' No matter what happens, I'll cheer 
you on to the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aah!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thank... you so much...!

Dantsu Flame's live stream, where she laid 
bare her true feelings, sparked huge buzz.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "...Um! Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Could our next target race... be the Japan 
Cup?

The Japan Cup is an international GⅠ held 
annually at Tokyo Racecourse. It is a 
grand stage that brings together not only 
Japan's fiercest competitors, but also 
many top talents from overseas.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I want to show it to all the fans.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I have no flair, no talent, no star 
quality, no potential, and I can't match 
up to my peers in any way—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, an ordinary Umamusume who 
even hurts her leg.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Standing right in the center of the 
era...!

As a stage for the current Dants Flame to 
shine, there could be no better place than 
the prestigious Japan Cup.

The next day, she declared her entry into 
the Japan Cup, vowing to stand at the 
center of the era—

And so began the days of sprinting 
relentlessly toward that towering peak!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thou art truly impressive, Lady Dants 
Flame! Both in thy races and in that 
stream thou hast done.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, how are you holding up? The 
'Tenno Sho (Autumn)' had quite an 
unexpected conclusion. Did it break your 
spirit after all?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............ No――my mission 
is――revolution―― It will never――change――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
If anything—I'm certain of it now... 
Surpassing her. That is precisely—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: A milestone... ...For my mission.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three key players assembled, and 
Lord Symboli Kris S is running too. Looks 
like it's going to be a wild 'Japan Cup'.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Drawn by the raging flames, a decisive 
battle for the realm. A fitting grand 
stage, whether one falls or survives—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kah-kah-kah-kah! I shall carve my banner 
into history!

The flame that Dantsu Flame displayed 
begins to move the hearts of every 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...'The center of the era', huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking the same back during the 
Satsuki Sho. Man, a whole lot has happened 
since then—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
After she was gone... I kept running like 
crazy, and eventually my legs gave out 
too...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ... ...In the end, the 'strongest' is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Hah!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If ya can't give up on it, then don't. 
...Right, Dants?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Let's decide who's strongest at the Japan 
Cup." ......

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I've already... at the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe—
(Tap)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Are you that drawn to it...? Are 
you really that...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...To the Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And now, the final corner! Dantsu Flame 
tears across the turf with tremendous 
momentum!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'strongest', you say. Are you sure 
you didn't send this to the wrong 
recipient, Pokke-kun?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"However... making such a rapid comeback 
from a leg issue. I never imagined she'd 
choose that path."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yet from what I can see, there's no issue 
with her bones or muscles. She wasn't 
unconsciously favoring anything either; in 
fact, if anything—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Does she even know the meaning of 
surrender, Dants Flame?! THIS is an 
indomitable Umamusume~~!!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My, oh my—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Why—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-chan!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, haa! Sorry for dropping in suddenly! 
I saw the group LANE, and Pokke-chan's 
message got me so hyped!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, so that was a LANE group chat. I 
didn't realize.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-chan, you're running too!? In the 
Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...No, I haven't decided that. We never 
talked about anything like that. That's 
practically one of Pokke's delusions— or 
rather, Dants. What about you—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why won't you give up?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Running should have been completely 
out of the question. Even if she could 
return, it would be walking hand-in-hand 
with career-ending injury."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The more you struggle to exceed your 
limits, the heavier the toll. Your room 
for growth... was supposed to have 
vanished that day.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to become like 
Tachyon-chan.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Sparkly and glamorous, leaving a lasting 
impression on everyone's hearts even as 
she departed.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Nobody could ever forget, not even for a 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because I desperately want to become a 
leading star just like you……!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Why can't you all... every last one of 
you... just hurry up and forget about it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Time doesn't stop. Eras change. It is far 
more constructive to love these 
ever-changing days.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'll never forget it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I could ever forget you, 
Tachyon-chan."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Tachyon-chan?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The passion of the turf, the yearning too. 
It's full of things that can only be found 
there—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's still... too early to give up, 
Tachyon-chan.

Carrying countless wishes. The autumn 
stage begins to take shape—
